boundary: this is a non-adopted digital candidate with no pressure, corrosion or suitability evidence.

panel_xyz_mm.basis: Vendor envelope, length/width order in CAD.

panel_mass_kg.basis: Vendor nominal mass per panel, not envelope density.

panel_gap_mm.basis: Inherited v2 design gap, not a vendor mounting requirement.

panel_tilt_deg.basis: Drainage study; allowed 3 to 5 degrees, no yield or load claim.

tray_xy_mm.basis: Shallow tray plan, 10 mm bearing overlap onto float collar on each side.

tray_thickness_mm.basis: Custom aluminum plate; stiffness and joints unqualified.

skirt_xy_mm.basis: Open-bottom skirt outer plan equals float inner plan; no sealed buoyancy credit.

skirt_wall_mm.basis: Custom sheet envelope; corner joining and ventilation review open.

skirt_depth_mm.basis: Skirt below tray, not a housing rating.

panel_low_clearance_mm.basis: Lowest panel underside above tray top, supported by wedges.

wedge_length_mm.basis: Solid candidate wedge rails; mounting/clamp zone not vendor-approved.

wedge_width_mm.basis: Candidate rail width, no fastener detail selected.

wedge_edge_inset_mm.basis: Rail centre inset from panel side edges.

hub_xyz_mm.basis: Vendor L/W/H laid flat; v2 vertical orientation is not retained.

hub_center_xy_mm.basis: Hub offset keeps central socket, pole and cable stubs clear.

shade_xy_mm.basis: Inherited v2 custom roof allocation, not a purchased roof.

shade_hub_gap_mm.basis: Inherited v2 shade gap; does not establish cooling or zero sunlight.

shade_to_tray_mm.basis: Roof top to tray underside; reopened thermal and service question.

shade_support_x_mm.basis: Two roof hangers outside hub envelope.

shade_support_xy_mm.basis: Unqualified roof attachment tabs; no fasteners populated.

sink_xyz_mm.basis: Sourced overall occupancy only. Vertical extrusion allocation beside flat hub, not a designed thermal joint.

sink_base_mm.basis: Sourced profile base thickness; not a complete sink solid.

sink_hub_gap_mm.basis: Inherited nominal TIM separation as space only; no thermal pad or contact assembly asserted.

sink_vent_height_mm.basis: Inherited minimum open-air allocation; skirt changes airflow.

hub_carrier_width_mm.basis: Shelf and two hangers outside roof ends; joining/load release open.

hub_hanger_xy_mm.basis: Two vertical carrier hangers touch tray underside; no bolt/weld sizing.

socket_id_mm.basis: 1 mm radial clearance around 60 mm pole; tolerances/isolation unqualified.

socket_length_mm.basis: Socket lower end to tray underside.

socket_flange_od_mm.basis: Custom flange touches tray underside; no bolt pattern invented.

socket_flange_thickness_mm.basis: Custom flange thickness; structural question open.

bolt_centres_below_tray_mm.basis: Two transverse X-axis cross-bolt allocations, not sourced fasteners.

bolt_hole_diameter_mm.basis: Holes through pole and socket with .5 mm radial allocation clearance.

bolt_allocation_diameter_mm.basis: Nonphysical shank space; grade, threads, heads, washers and locking unselected.

bolt_allocation_length_mm.basis: Nonphysical cross-bolt space, not a vendor length.

pole_od_mm.basis: User-requested pole interface; no selected vendor tube.

pole_wall_mm.basis: Hollow flooded steel tube study, no tube buoyancy credit or strength claim.

site_depth_mm.basis: Copied illustrative site scene 6.4 m depth; R5R6 has no farm bathymetric survey. Not maximum inlet depth.

freeboard_mm.basis: Tray underside and pole top above reference waterline. Pole length = depth + freeboard; zero embedment modeled.

footing_xy_mm.basis: Seabed footing plate outline, not an anchor/holding-capacity design.

footing_thickness_mm.basis: Plate top at seabed datum, plate extends below it; no concrete or embedment asserted.

float_outer_xy_mm.basis: Rectangular closed-cell foam collar; inner opening from skirt plan.

float_height_mm.basis: Foam collar height; no sealed skirt/hub displacement credit.

cable_diameter_mm.basis: Inherited cable route allocation, not a selected cable diameter.

cable_bend_radius_mm.basis: Inherited routing radius assumption; stubs are not complete bent harnesses.

cable_x_mm.basis: Two vertical route stubs at panel centres, outside hub, shade and carrier hangers.

cable_stub_z_mm.basis: Stub ends relative to tray underside. Gland/junction positions and real route unresolved.

cable_hole_diameter_mm.basis: Tray pass-through clearance only; no gland or ingress claim.

aluminum_density_kg_m3.basis: Assumed custom aluminum density; never applied to purchased panel or hub envelopes.

steel_density_kg_m3.basis: Assumed pole/footing density; actual grade and corrosion isolation unselected.

foam_density_kg_m3.basis: Assumed dry closed-cell foam bulk density, no product/source or water-uptake evidence.

seawater_density_kg_m3.basis: Assumed seawater density; not measured at site.

hub_scenario_mass_kg.basis: Explicit illustrative hub dry mass, NOT vendor mass and NOT solid-envelope density. Actual unknown.

sink_scenario_mass_kg.basis: Illustrative sink allowance independent of occupancy volume; actual unknown, no fin geometry inferred.

unmodeled_payload_allowance_kg.basis: Illustrative mass contingency only; not a modeled battery, power integration or complete mass allowance.

gravity_m_s2.basis: Conventional gravity for conditional force arithmetic.

brep_tolerance_mm.basis: Digital comparison tolerance only, not a manufacturing tolerance.

interference_tolerance_mm3.basis: OCP common-volume numerical threshold, not allowable interference.

glb_deflection_mm.basis: Display tessellation, source BRep remains authoritative.

dxf_curve_spacing_mm.basis: Sampled orthographic curves; exact geometry stays in STEP.

dxf_view_gap_mm.basis: Drawing layout, not a part dimension.

surface_height_limit_mm.basis: Digital shallow-layout screen for common surface only, excluding the mutually exclusive mounts; not a physical rating.

dxf_text_height_mm.basis: Drawing annotation height, not a part dimension.

float.waterline: Conditional mass-scenario equilibrium, not measured draft

thermal.note: Heat-sink occupancy retains vertical extrusion allocation, but lies beside the flat hub. No designed contact path, fin detail or performance claim.

interface.reuse_rights: Vendor dimension provenance retained; no blanket licence or public redistribution authorization. No new downloads.
interface.required_sentence: this is a non-adopted digital candidate with no pressure, corrosion or suitability evidence.
open_gates: G01 exact supplied panel/hub revisions, mounting zones, component inspection and unknown purchased masses
G02 battery, BMS, charger, protection, regulators, wiring, glands and full power integration omitted and unresolved
G03 reopened thermal analysis: v2 48 W absorbed-sun and 21.9 W enclosed-heat budgets not re-evaluated; flat hub thermal contact and ventilation unresolved
G04 pole bending, buckling, cross-bolts, flange joints, wind fatigue and corrosion isolation
G05 seabed survey, footing holding capacity, pole embedment/anchoring and recovery; zero embedment modeled
G06 wind, waves, storm current, mooring load and farm-line clearance require site/engineer review
G07 actual complete mass, CG, float water uptake, freeboard, stability, wave response and buoyancy unknown
G08 cable bend/pull, terminations, service access, splash ingress, corrosion and fouling
G09 farm/operator permissions, marking, loss prevention, retrieval and vendor-derived redistribution rights

parts.name: SV3_POLE_60MM

parts.name: SV3_SEABED_FOOTING_PLATE

parts.name: SV3_CABLE_ROUTE_ALLOCATION_A

parts.name: SV3_CABLE_ROUTE_ALLOCATION_B
